shortDescription: British pub chain JD Wetherspoon LSE:JDW said on Wednesday like-for-like sales rose 8.2% in the 14 weeks to November 1, though growth slowed in the latest five weeks, and it remained comfortable with market expectations for the year.($1 = 0.7433 pounds)

children: said on Wednesday like-for-like sales rose 8.2% in the 14 weeks to November 1, though growth slowed in the latest five weeks, and it remained comfortable with market expectations for the year.
The pub operator, known colloquially as Spoons, said like-for-like sales growth eased to 7.5% in the most recent five weeks from 8.6% in the preceding nine weeks
Chairman Tim Martin said the company was comfortable with current market expectations
“The company has had a good start to the financial year. There are still three quarters to go and profit forecasts are very dependent on the level of sales growth," said Martin

The analysts' consensus profit estimate for fiscal 2027, compiled by the company, is £76.4 million ($102.8 million) for a 53-week year, compared with profit of £77.7 million in fiscal 2026, on an adjusted basis
